name.sw: Nyumbani

who.en:
For a household in Dar es Salaam: a small household of two or three people, or a family of five or six. The box brings, every month, what a home uses to keep hands washed, drinking water safe, mosquitoes off the family and the toilet, kitchen and floors clean, with a small first-aid refill. The first box also brings treated nets, a first-aid box and a thermometer.

It is built on WHO guidance. Contaminated drinking water causes about 505,000 diarrhoeal deaths a year, and safe water, sanitation and hygiene are essential to prevent cholera. Chlorinating stored water at home was the main household defence in Tanzania’s cholera epidemic. For malaria, WHO advises sleeping under a treated net, with repellent and other measures in the evening. WHO’s Five Keys to Safer Food start with keeping hands, surfaces and dishes clean.

Quantities are measured to the month for the size of the household. Afya does not sell medicines: the oral rehydration salts in the first-aid box come from the licensed partner pharmacy.
who.sw:
Kwa kaya ya Dar es Salaam: kaya ndogo ya watu wawili au watatu, au familia ya watu watano au sita. Kila mwezi boksi linaleta kile ambacho nyumba hutumia kunawa mikono, kuweka maji ya kunywa salama, kuzuia mbu kwa familia na kuweka choo, jiko na sakafu safi, pamoja na kujaza kidogo sanduku la huduma ya kwanza. Boksi la kwanza pia linaleta vyandarua vyenye dawa, sanduku la huduma ya kwanza na kipimajoto.

Limejengwa juu ya miongozo ya WHO. Maji machafu ya kunywa husababisha vifo takriban 505,000 vya kuharisha kila mwaka, na maji salama, usafi wa mazingira na usafi binafsi ni muhimu kuzuia kipindupindu. Kutia klorini maji yaliyohifadhiwa nyumbani ndiyo ilikuwa kinga kuu ya kaya wakati wa mlipuko wa kipindupindu Tanzania. Kuhusu malaria, WHO inashauri kulala ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa, pamoja na dawa ya kufukuza mbu na hatua nyingine jioni. Funguo Tano za WHO za Chakula Salama zinaanza na kuweka mikono, sehemu na vyombo safi.

Kiasi kimepimwa kwa mwezi kulingana na ukubwa wa kaya. Afya haiuzi dawa: chumvi za kurudisha maji mwilini zilizo kwenye sanduku la huduma ya kwanza zinatoka kwa famasia mshirika yenye leseni.

clinic_line.en: First aid is for small injuries only. For a fever, test for malaria at a health facility; for a deep wound, a burn larger than the palm, or diarrhoea with weakness, go to a clinic straight away. Any medicine comes from the licensed partner pharmacy, as a clinician advises.
clinic_line.sw: Huduma ya kwanza ni kwa majeraha madogo tu. Ukiwa na homa, pima malaria kituo cha afya; kwa jeraha kubwa, jeraha la moto kubwa kuliko kiganja, au kuharisha pamoja na udhaifu, nenda kliniki mara moja. Dawa yoyote inatoka kwa famasia mshirika yenye leseni, kama mtaalamu wa afya anavyoshauri.

guidance.t: WHO fact sheet, Malaria (nets, repellents with DEET, IR3535 or icaridin, coils and vaporizers; ITNs and IRS as the two core vector controls)
WHO fact sheet, Drinking-water (about 505,000 diarrhoeal deaths a year from contaminated drinking water; household water treatment scheme)
WHO fact sheet, Cholera (safe water, sanitation and hygiene essential; most cases treated with oral rehydration solution)
WHO 2006, Five keys to safer food manual (keep clean; separate raw and cooked; cook thoroughly; safe temperatures; safe water and raw materials)
WHO fact sheet, Burns (first aid: cool running water about 20 minutes; clean non-adherent dressing)
CDC MMWR 65(41), 2016: chlorination of drinking water during the cholera epidemic in Tanzania. Cited from the old code; not re-opened
WaterGuard liquid instructions in Kiswahili (FHI 360 / PSI): one capful per 20 L, wait 30 minutes. Cited from the old code; not re-opened

name.en: Liquid hand soap for the sink
name.sw: Sabuni ya maji ya kunawa mikono

why.en: Handwashing with soap is the first barrier against diarrhoea and cholera. WHO names safe water, sanitation and hygiene as essential to prevent cholera. A pump at the sink makes it easy to wash after the toilet and before food.
why.sw: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni ni kinga ya kwanza dhidi ya kuharisha na kipindupindu. WHO inataja maji salama, usafi wa mazingira na usafi binafsi kuwa muhimu kuzuia kipindupindu. Sabuni ya pampu kwenye sinki hurahisisha kunawa baada ya choo na kabla ya kula.

name.sw: Chandarua chenye dawa cha muda mrefu

why.en: WHO names insecticide-treated nets and indoor residual spraying as the two core malaria vector controls. One treated net for every sleeping space; the first box brings them, replaced when torn.
why.sw: WHO inataja vyandarua vyenye dawa na upuliziaji wa ukoko wa dawa ndani ya nyumba kuwa kinga kuu mbili dhidi ya mbu wa malaria. Chandarua kimoja chenye dawa kwa kila sehemu ya kulala; boksi la kwanza linavileta, na hubadilishwa vikichanika.

starter.qty_formula: 1 net per sleeping space × 3 sleeping spaces (about 2 people per net)

name.en: Oral rehydration salts, for the first-aid box (partner pharmacy)
name.sw: Chumvi za kurudisha maji mwilini, kwa sanduku la huduma ya kwanza (famasia mshirika)

why.en: WHO: most people with cholera can be treated with oral rehydration solution, and starting quickly saves lives. Keeping a few sachets at home lets treatment start while the family goes to a clinic. Supplied by the licensed partner pharmacy, not priced in the box.
why.sw: WHO: wagonjwa wengi wa kipindupindu wanaweza kutibiwa kwa mchanganyiko wa chumvi za kurudisha maji mwilini, na kuanza mapema huokoa maisha. Kuweka pakiti chache nyumbani huwezesha kuanza wakati familia inaelekea kliniki. Hutolewa na famasia mshirika yenye leseni, haziwekwi bei kwenye boksi.

starter.qty_formula: 6 sachets kept in the first-aid box; replaced when used

tiers.en: Regular = the core box with default brands. Premium = core + the premium item. Luxury = core + the luxury item. The luxury item is priced as its own line at shelf price, outside the saving (D4).
tiers.sw: Kawaida = boksi la msingi lenye chapa za msingi. Premium = boksi la msingi + bidhaa ya premium. Anasa = boksi la msingi + bidhaa ya anasa. Bidhaa ya anasa ina bei yake peke yake kwa bei ya rafu, nje ya punguzo (D4).

name.sw: Kipimo cha klorini ya maji ya kunywa

what.en: The store adviser tests a sample of the family’s treated water for free chlorine and shows the right dose.
what.sw: Mshauri wa duka hupima sampuli ya maji yaliyotibiwa ya familia kuona klorini na kuonyesha kipimo sahihi.

name.sw: Kipimo cha shinikizo la damu kwa familia

what.en: Any adult in the household can have blood pressure and weight checked in the store each month.
what.sw: Mtu mzima yeyote wa kaya anaweza kupimwa shinikizo la damu na uzito dukani kila mwezi.

name.sw: Ziara ya kudhibiti wadudu nyumbani (nyongeza)

what.en: A licensed pest-control company treats the home for cockroaches and rodents.
what.sw: Kampuni yenye leseni ya kudhibiti wadudu hutibu nyumba dhidi ya mende na panya.

services_detail.src: model.js services.packs (planning figure, no partner quote)

starter_rule.en: Starter items come once, in the first box, charged once at shelf price (no saving), with no extra delivery.
starter_rule.sw: Bidhaa za kuanzia zinakuja mara moja, kwenye boksi la kwanza, zinalipiwa mara moja kwa bei ya rafu (bila punguzo), bila usafirishaji wa ziada.

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the monthly box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (S 3,500 · M 5,000 · L 6,500 per box) and one delivery 3,500 included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares 78% brand / 72% pharm / 50% own) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0. Service fee = r500(partner price × 1.25), partner price = r500(walk-in × 0.70), charged in the month delivered.
